overall_reason: The installation guide's tabs mark the selected platform, the FAQ disclosures open in place and the download cards separate a recommended installer from the alternatives, but the three recommended download buttons are too narrow for their labels and clip their download icons, and the phone header drops the Download action.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I passes on the guide tabs and T-OVERLAY-CHECK on the FAQ, with gaps in T-ONE-FAMILY (clipped installer buttons, CMP-265; the selected tab drawn as a primary button, CMP-005) and T-PHONE-NAV (no Download in the 375 header, CMP-011).

visitor_mode: Persuade into a download: the landing page of a desktop app, with platform-specific installers and an install guide. No 00-contract.md; inferred from 'Get KinAI for Free', the header 'Download' and the per-platform installer cards.

findings.title: Fit the text before the box: a control's border-box holds content, padding and border
findings.where: Get KinAI download cards, recommended buttons, 1440, tiles/1440-06.png
findings.evidence: The filled teal buttons 'Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)', 'MSI Installer (Recommended)' and 'AppImage (Recommended)' run their label to the right edge, and the download icon at the end of each is cut off by the button's border; the outlined alternatives below ('Intel Mac', 'EXE Installer (Alternative)') keep their icon inside.
findings.before: The label and icon overflow the 254px button, so the download icon is clipped.
findings.after: A shorter label ('Download for Apple silicon') or a button that grows to its content, with the icon inside the padding.
findings.why: The main download on each platform card is the one control that looks broken.

findings.title: Controls belong to one family
findings.evidence: The selected tab 'Mac Host' uses the same teal fill (rgb(0, 209, 195)) as the 'Download' and 'Get KinAI for Free' buttons; the buttons table lists it as a filled variant, and the screen above it already carries three teal download buttons.
findings.before: The selected tab looks like a fourth primary button on the screen.
findings.after: The selected tab as a raised neutral segment or an underline, keeping teal for download actions.
findings.why: A visitor reading the screen sees four teal buttons and cannot tell which one downloads.

findings.title: The phone gets the whole navigation
findings.evidence: phone_nav lists only the 'v0.2.148' link and a GitHub icon at 375; the header's teal 'Download' button is gone and there is no menu button. The targets sweep flags the GitHub icon at 20x20.
findings.before: The phone header offers a version badge and a 20px GitHub icon, not the download.
findings.after: 'Download' kept in the 375 header, or a bar with it once the hero button scrolls off (CMP-168).
findings.why: A phone visitor past the hero has no way to the download until the installer section.

strengths: The Installation Guide tabs (Mac Host, Mac Client, Windows, Linux) mark the selected one and swap the panel in place (motion/t0-normal-600.png).
Each platform card pairs one recommended filled installer with outlined alternatives that each carry a download icon, so the default choice is clear.
The FAQ uses disclosure rows that open in place ('Can my phone or iPad install KinAI directly?' opens 'Not yet — there is no native iOS or Android…').

One filled primary in the hero ('Get KinAI for Free') beside an outlined 'View Setup Guide'; the stylesheet declares hover in a hover media query (5), focus-visible (20), disabled (15) and current or selected (21) rules.
not_investigated: The download itself and any failure: the installers are links to releases; the async capture found no primary action to hold or fail.
What a phone visitor sees beyond the header menu: there is no menu button, and triggers are opened at 1440 only.
Two icon-only buttons the capture clicked (triggers t2, t3) have no name in the components table; naming is the sweep's (control_names found none missing).
Inline validation and error placement: no fields.
Keyboard operation of the tabs and disclosures: lens-a11y.
Disclosure motion (motion_snap hits on the FAQ): lens-motion.
T-FIELD-READ, T-ERROR-PATH and T-TABLE-READ: no field, no failure run and no table.
